rapport_notes: Friendly and personable early on, but rapport fades as call becomes transactional; rep recovers warmth at end but overall tone is functional rather than engaged.
process_discipline_notes: No repeats detected; silence handling is weak (no held silence after open-ended questions), but no differentiators were explicitly restated.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says: 'I'd love to get you that quote. Let me go ahead and just take a couple of pieces of information and that way I can kind of make sure that the rate is correct' — frames the ask but does not promise an accurate quote or time-box the conversation.
evidence_quotes.agenda_missing: Rep never asks 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' or any recognizable version. Launches directly into logistics probing after opening rapport.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep_missing: Customer mentions 'trying to get things lined up' and 'bringing my dad home from rehab,' but rep does not probe these at all — no 'tell me more about that' or follow-up.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Rep states: 'And then we do have our on time guarantee now. Right now I do have an available truck for Friday September 11th with an arrival time between 1:30 and two.' — Guarantee mentioned but not explained as a differentiator; no detail on what it means.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep says: 'And so I am getting you at like that minimum two and a half to bring and a half hour range because this is all we're moving... the two and a half to three and a half does include the drive.' — Provides a range but does not anchor to a typical move or personalize beyond 'all we're moving.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_window: Rep explains: 'We always like to just give a range but if this is all we have then I mean I would think that you're going to be closer to that $640, that minimum and this is because we do have a trip fee that's included in that.' — Acknowledges the estimate as a range but does not name specific factors driving variance.
evidence_quotes.close_missing: Call ends with 'I'm sending this email over to your inbox right now' and 'pleasure talking to you this morning and hope we hear from you soon' — no rate-lock statement, no explicit ask to book, no commitment mechanism.

top_strength: Rep handled multiple logistics details (addresses, zip codes, floor-to-floor, parking) accurately and systematically, keeping the call organized and building a solid quote.
coaching_note: Never ask the customer's agenda — this is the single highest-priority line in the script and the foundation of everything else; without it, you miss the real concerns behind the move and can't build trust or differentiate on what matters to them.
